unit.why: A brief memorate: R. Yitzhak Isaac of Zhidachov testifies that his teacher R. Zvi Hirsh, though the elder brother, stood at full height before R. Yissachar Ber and said he did not reach his ankles in fear of Heaven. It is a habitual act with a saying, so it is borderline between story and trait-praise.
unit.boundary_note: part of a numbered series of praises of R. Yissachar Ber; (ד) in the next division is a separate item

stories.start_quote: העיד מורינו בנו הנ"ל מוהרי״א מזידיטשוב
stories.summary_en: R. Yitzhak Isaac of Zhidachov testifies that his master R. Zvi Hirsh, although the elder brother, used to stand at full height before his younger brother R. Yissachar Ber and declare that he did not reach his ankles in fear of Heaven.

tags.why: the point is to praise the piety of R. Yissachar Ber
fear of Heaven is the praised quality
the elder brother and master humbles himself before his younger brother
